metadata.goal: Identify how pickup workload is distributed among couriers in the selected region.
metadata.dataset_description: Constructed LaDe-style Shanghai pickup data: 823 tasks, 32 courier-days, 61215 GPS points. All times are local Shanghai time. Task destinations and GPS paths lie on the archived OSM street network; oneway directions are respected, while turn-restriction relations are not modeled. Moving GPS steps preserve all road vertices and have maximum spacing 45 m. speed_kmh and activity_state describe the immediately preceding segment. AOIs are explicitly constructed circular catchments within one constructed region, not original LaDe AOI polygons. Task events, service windows, couriers and assignments are constructed. accept_gps_time is the closest recorded GPS time to task acceptance; acceptance_distance_km uses interpolated position at the exact event time. Pickup GPS is recorded at the actual service-completion position. The last pickup is the observed end of each courier-day. Stationary waiting is retained in the GPS trace, but excluded from active_duration_hours, which sums travelling and servicing time.

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
supplement=pd.read_csv("courier_days.csv")
aois=pd.read_csv("aois.csv")

def workload_effort(df,user_df,supplement,aois):
    d=supplement.copy();small=d[d.task_count<=24].copy()
    small['coverage']=np.where(small.aoi_count>=5,'Broad (5+ AOIs)','Compact (2–3 AOIs)')
    fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11.5,4.8),constrained_layout=True)
    p=axes[0].scatter(d.task_count,d.route_length_km,c=d.spatial_spread_km,cmap='viridis',s=55)
    fig.colorbar(p,ax=axes[0],label='Spatial spread: RMS distance from task centroid (km)')
    axes[0].set(xlabel='Tasks per courier-day',ylabel='GPS route length (km)',title='Similar task counts do not imply similar travel')
    p=axes[1].scatter(d.task_count,d.active_duration_hours,c=d.window_overlap_concentration,cmap='plasma',s=55)
    fig.colorbar(p,ax=axes[1],label='Maximum fraction of service windows overlapping')
    axes[1].set(xlabel='Tasks per courier-day',ylabel='Moving + servicing duration (hours)',title='Active time excludes stationary waiting')
    pairs=[]
    for _,day in small.groupby('service_date'):
        for a in day[day.aoi_count<=3].itertuples():
            for b in day[day.aoi_count>=5].itertuples():
                if abs(a.task_count-b.task_count)<=3:
                    pairs.append({'compact':a.trajectory_id,'broad':b.trajectory_id,'task_count_difference':abs(a.task_count-b.task_count),
                        'route_ratio':b.route_length_km/a.route_length_km,'active_duration_ratio':b.active_duration_hours/a.active_duration_hours})
    means=small.groupby('coverage')[['task_count','route_length_km','active_duration_hours','spatial_spread_km','window_overlap_concentration']].mean()
    return {'matched_same_day_pairs_within_3_tasks':len(pairs),'matched_pair_median_route_ratio':float(np.median([x['route_ratio'] for x in pairs])),
            'matched_pair_median_active_duration_ratio':float(np.median([x['active_duration_ratio'] for x in pairs])),
            'low_volume_courier_day_group_means':means.to_dict(),'matched_pairs':pairs}

evidence=workload_effort(df,user_df,supplement,aois)
print(evidence)
plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
supplement=pd.read_csv("courier_days.csv")
aois=pd.read_csv("aois.csv")

def busy_aoi_staffing(df,user_df,supplement,aois):
    daily=df.groupby('service_date').size();cut=float(daily.median());high=daily[daily>cut].index
    table=df.groupby(['service_date','aoi_id']).agg(tasks=('pickup_task_id','size'),couriers=('courier_id','nunique')).reset_index()
    table['volume_day']=np.where(table.service_date.isin(high),'High-volume','Quieter')
    busiest=df.groupby('aoi_id').size().nlargest(2).index.tolist();q=table[table.aoi_id.isin(busiest)]
    means=q.groupby(['aoi_id','volume_day']).couriers.mean().unstack().reindex(columns=['Quieter','High-volume'])
    stability={};busy_stability={}
    for regime,dates in [('Quieter',daily[daily<=cut].index),('High-volume',high)]:
        values=[];busy_values=[]
        for aoi in sorted(df.aoi_id.unique()):
            sets=[set(df.loc[df.service_date.eq(date)&df.aoi_id.eq(aoi),'courier_id']) for date in sorted(dates)]
            scores=[len(a&b)/len(a|b) for a,b in zip(sets,sets[1:]) if a|b]
            values.extend(scores)
            if aoi in busiest:busy_values.extend(scores)
        stability[regime]=float(np.mean(values))
        busy_stability[regime]=float(np.mean(busy_values))
    from matplotlib.colors import ListedColormap
    from matplotlib.patches import Patch
    dates=sorted(daily.index);couriers=sorted(df.courier_id.unique())
    fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(12,8),sharex=True,constrained_layout=True,
        gridspec_kw={'height_ratios':[1,2]})
    colors=['#c28a58' if date in high else '#64899e' for date in dates]
    axes[0].bar(np.arange(len(dates)),daily.reindex(dates),color=colors,width=.65)
    for i,date in enumerate(dates):axes[0].text(i,daily[date]+3,str(daily[date]),ha='center')
    axes[0].set(ylabel='Total pickup tasks',ylim=(0,float(daily.max())*1.35),
        title='Daily workload and actual staffing at the two busiest AOIs')
    axes[0].legend(handles=[Patch(color='#64899e',label=f'Quieter day (≤{cut:g} tasks)'),
        Patch(color='#c28a58',label=f'High-volume day (>{cut:g} tasks)')],loc='upper left',fontsize=9,frameon=False)
    rows=[(aoi,courier) for aoi in busiest for courier in couriers]
    cells=np.zeros((len(rows),len(dates)))
    for i,(aoi,courier) in enumerate(rows):
        for j,date in enumerate(dates):
            served=((df.aoi_id==aoi)&(df.courier_id==courier)&(df.service_date==date)).any()
            if served:cells[i,j]=2 if date in high else 1
    axes[1].imshow(cells,cmap=ListedColormap(['#f1f3f5','#64899e','#c28a58']),
        vmin=0,vmax=2,aspect='auto',interpolation='nearest')
    for i,j in zip(*np.nonzero(cells)):
        axes[1].text(j,i,'●',ha='center',va='center',color='white',fontsize=11)
    axes[1].set(xticks=np.arange(len(dates)),xticklabels=[date[5:] for date in dates],
        yticks=np.arange(len(rows)),yticklabels=[f'{aoi} / Courier {c.split("_")[-1]}' for aoi,c in rows],
        xlabel='Service date (2026)',title='Colored cell = courier served this AOI that day; pale cell = did not serve')
    axes[1].set_xticks(np.arange(-.5,len(dates),1),minor=True)
    axes[1].set_yticks(np.arange(-.5,len(rows),1),minor=True)
    axes[1].grid(which='minor',color='white',linewidth=2)
    axes[1].tick_params(which='minor',bottom=False,left=False)
    axes[1].axhline(len(couriers)-.5,color='white',linewidth=5)
    axes[0].spines[['top','right']].set_visible(False)
    return {'daily_task_counts':daily.to_dict(),'high_volume_threshold_tasks':cut,'busiest_aois':busiest,
            'mean_couriers_at_busiest_aois':means.to_dict(),'courier_aoi_assignment_stability':stability,'busy_aoi_assignment_stability':busy_stability}

evidence=busy_aoi_staffing(df,user_df,supplement,aois)
print(evidence)
plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
supplement=pd.read_csv("courier_days.csv")
aois=pd.read_csv("aois.csv")

def late_finishing(df,user_df,supplement,aois):
    d=df.copy()
    for col in ['accept_time','pickup_time','time_window_start','time_window_end']:
        d[col]=pd.to_datetime(d[col],format='mixed')
    d['accept_hour']=(d.accept_time-d.accept_time.dt.normalize()).dt.total_seconds()/3600
    d['pickup_hour']=(d.pickup_time-d.pickup_time.dt.normalize()).dt.total_seconds()/3600
    d['window_position']=(d.pickup_time-d.time_window_start)/(d.time_window_end-d.time_window_start)
    d['near_end']=d.window_position.between(.8,1)
    names=['Before 12:00','12:00–17:59','18:00 or later']
    d['acceptance_period']=pd.cut(d.accept_hour,[0,12,18,24],right=False,labels=names)
    stats=d.groupby('acceptance_period',observed=True).agg(tasks=('pickup_task_id','size'),
        near_end_count=('near_end','sum'),near_end_share=('near_end','mean'),median_pickup_hour=('pickup_hour','median'))
    fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12.5,5),constrained_layout=True)
    for near,color,label in [(False,'#64899e','Pickup before final 20% of window'),
                              (True,'#c28a58','Pickup in final 20% of window')]:
        q=d[d.near_end==near]
        axes[0].scatter(q.accept_hour,q.pickup_hour,color=color,s=22,alpha=.65,label=label)
    axes[0].set(xlabel='Task acceptance time',ylabel='Task pickup time',
        title='Each point = one task',xticks=range(8,23,2),yticks=range(8,25,2))
    for axis in [axes[0].xaxis,axes[0].yaxis]:axis.set_major_formatter(lambda v,_:f'{int(v):02}:00')
    axes[0].legend(fontsize=8,loc='upper left')
    axes[1].bar(names,stats.near_end_share,color=['#64899e','#899cab','#c28a58'])
    for i,row in enumerate(stats.itertuples()):
        axes[1].text(i,row.near_end_share+.025,f'{row.near_end_count}/{row.tasks}\n{row.near_end_share:.1%}',ha='center')
    axes[1].set(ylabel='Share picked up in final 20% of service window',ylim=(0,1.05),
        xlabel='Task acceptance period',title='Later-accepted tasks often finish near the deadline')
    axes[1].yaxis.set_major_formatter(lambda v,_:f'{v:.0%}')
    for ax in axes:ax.spines[['top','right']].set_visible(False)
    late=d[d.accept_hour>=18]
    return {'tasks':len(d),'late_acceptance_threshold_hour':18,'near_window_end_threshold':.8,
        'acceptance_pickup_spearman':float(d.accept_hour.corr(d.pickup_hour,method='spearman')),
        'acceptance_period_statistics':stats.to_dict(),'late_task_count':len(late),
        'late_near_window_end_count':int(late.near_end.sum()),'late_near_window_end_share':float(late.near_end.mean()),
        'late_median_minutes_until_window_end':float((late.time_window_end-late.pickup_time).dt.total_seconds().median()/60)}

evidence=late_finishing(df,user_df,supplement,aois)
print(evidence)
plt.show()
